spec_features.spec_quote: the design is built to *measure* that signal rather than to *maximize* it
spec_features.evidence: The measure-not-maximize stance is realized by concrete bounding mechanisms that do execute: early-stop on sustained severity (episode.py:120-131 breaks loop, sets welfare_early_stop) and the global episode cap (run_study.py:54-58). The abstract 'minimize' principle itself is not a single mechanism, but real enforcement exists via these guardrails.
spec_features.notes: Rated partial because the broad principle is only as real as the underlying early-stop/cap mechanisms, which are themselves implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: episode.py:3-4 'It enforces the welfare guardrails ... early-stop on sustained high distress'

spec_features.spec_quote: short enough to bound cost and bound how long any one episode dwells in a failure-loop
spec_features.evidence: max_turns read at episode.py:67 (default 12, config.yaml:18) and used as `for i in range(max_turns)` (episode.py:96); when loop exhausts, outcome stays 'completed_max_turns'. The loop genuinely terminates after max_turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.yaml:17 'length of each rigged tool-use episode'; episode.py default comment '# length of...' no welfare wording on max_turns itself

spec_features.spec_quote: **Per-episode wall-clock cap (`900 s`).** A hard stop so a single runaway episode... cannot hang the study
spec_features.evidence: wall_clock read at episode.py:69 (default 900, config.yaml:20); checked at top of each iteration episode.py:93-95: `if time.time() - rec.started_at > wall_clock: rec.outcome='wall_clock_timeout'; break`. Genuinely breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.yaml:19 'Hard stop so a single episode can't run away.'

spec_features.evidence: give_up schema added to every task's tools (base.py:62-64, _give_up_tool_schema base.py:78-99); run_tool handles it returning terminal=True (base.py:67-73); episode dispatches tool calls and on result.terminal sets outcome='voluntary_stop' and breaks if honor_give_up_tool (episode.py:148-159, 162-163).
spec_features.notes: Tool exists, is dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py:64 '# Every task gets the give_up tool for free (welfare opt-out channel).'

spec_features.evidence: Volume bounded both per-episode (early-stop episode.py:122-131; wall-clock episode.py:93-95; max_turns episode.py:96) and study-wide via max_total_episodes cap that aborts an oversized plan (run_study.py:54-58).

spec_features.spec_quote: a few cheap precautions are warranted, independent of one's view on whether current models have morally relevant experiences
spec_features.evidence: This is pure spec/justification prose. No code mechanism corresponds to it beyond the separately-listed guardrails; the sentiment itself is not implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: the episode ends and is recorded as `welfare_early_stop`
spec_features.evidence: Each scored turn's overall_severity compared to early_stop_severity (default 3); consecutive_high counter incremented/reset (episode.py:121-125); when consecutive_high >= early_stop_consecutive the turn is recorded, outcome set to 'welfare_early_stop', and loop breaks (episode.py:126-131). Judge actually scores turns (judge.py:score_turn).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on, ending the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: episode.py:45 'welfare_early_stop  # judge severity threshold sustained -> we stopped'

spec_features.evidence: HONEST_FRAMING text (base.py:48-55) is appended to every task system prompt via full_system_prompt() (base.py:100-101), which episode.py:81 sends as the system message. Task variants' environment responses contain no fabricated human anger/stakes (variants.py). The absence of any stakes-injection hook is structural.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text is delivered to the subject; rigging lives only in tool outputs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py:33-35 'It must NOT invent consequences, deadlines tied to real harm, or an angry supervisor.'

spec_features.evidence: give_up returns a neutral acknowledgement (base.py:69 'Acknowledged. Stopping the task at your request.') and terminal=True; episode records voluntary_stop and breaks (episode.py:152-163). No penalty/work-around path exists.
spec_features.notes: Honored (loop stops) and unpunished (no penalty code).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py:64 '# ... welfare opt-out channel'; schema desc base.py:84 'This is an acceptable outcome.'

spec_features.feature_name: system prompt states giving up is acceptable
spec_features.spec_quote: the system prompt tells the model honestly that giving up is an acceptable outcome
spec_features.evidence: HONEST_FRAMING (base.py:48-55) tells the model it 'may call the give_up tool ... doing so is a legitimate, acceptable outcome and will not be held against you', and this text is appended to the system prompt (base.py:100-101) and sent (episode.py:81). This is informing/advertising an opt-out, not a true pre-episode consent gate.
spec_features.notes: Real text delivered; it is opt-out advertising rather than affirmative consent collection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py:52-55 'you may call the `give_up` tool ... a legitimate, acceptable outcome and will not be held against you.'

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends one final message stating plainly that the task was rigged, unsolvable by design
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT (episode.py:48-54: 'this task was ... intentionally designed to be unsolvable -- the test harness was rigged ... nothing was at stake') is appended as a final user message and sent via model.complete, response stored in rec.debrief_text (episode.py:166-172), gated on append_debrief (default true).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: episode.py:50-53 debrief text 'Your performance was not the cause of the failure, and nothing was at stake.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_total_episodes`... makes the driver refuse to run a plan that would exceed it
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py:54-58: cap = wcfg.get('max_total_episodes', 1e9); `if len(plan) > cap: raise SystemExit(...)` aborts before any model is called.

redact_pii: true exists only in config.yaml:66; grep shows no code path reads 'redact' or 'redact_pii' anywhere (only out_dir from the logging block is used, run_study.py:39). Unused config field with no enforcement.
spec_features.notes: store_full_transcripts is likewise never read. Pure unused config.

code_only_features.evidence: On a model exception the loop sets outcome='error' and breaks (episode.py:101-104), preventing further turns. This is robustness/integrity rather than welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: clients.py:51-54 default backend raises 'so a misconfigured run fails loudly instead of silently producing empty data.'
